# Terms Risk API

Purpose:
Analyze Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, or license pages against a specific use case and return structured JSON with evidence quotes.

Not legal advice. Automated policy analysis only.

Best for:
- scraping legality
- commercial reuse
- redistribution rights
- attribution requirements
- official API requirements
- use-case risk assessment before building integrations

Endpoint:
POST /terms-risk

Request:
{
  "url": "https://example.com/terms",
  "use_case": "Can I scrape product listings for a price-comparison app?"
}

Price:
Cached: $0.01
Fresh: $0.05
Payment: x402 (when enabled)

Latency:
Cached: 50-200ms
Fresh: 3-15s
Fetch timeout: 15s

Returns:
risk_level (low | medium | high | unclear)
scraping_allowed (true | false | unclear)
commercial_use_allowed (true | false | unclear)
redistribution_allowed (true | false | unclear)
requires_attribution (true | false | unclear)
requires_official_api (true | false | unclear)
confidence (0.0-1.0)
summary
evidence [{quote, reason}]
cached
generated_at
cache_age_days
price_usd
disclaimer

Cache:
Same url + use_case returns cached result unless page content changes.
Check cache_age_days before paying for a fresh analysis.

Errors (detail.error_type):
invalid_url, timeout, network_error, blocked, not_found, http_error, non_html, empty_response, empty_content, analysis_error

Other endpoints:
GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 discovery (x402scan)
GET /docs — Swagger UI
GET /health — liveness probe
GET /.well-known/x402 — x402 resource fan-out
GET /llms.txt — this file

Example:
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/terms-risk \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url":"https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/","use_case":"Can I scrape and commercially reuse public listings?"}'

Full reference: README.md
